name: hadir
description: HADIR — instrumen audit warga untuk layanan bus bersubsidi

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml exec postgres psql -U hadir -d hadir
